title: Not finishing college; bricklaying while aiming to be a songwriter
summary: His father made him lay bricks after he quit college; coworkers laughed at his songwriting ambitions.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Well, now, did you study music in college?

No, I studied music aside. Just like I said, as I was getting experience with the band, I began to study music in Harlem. Well, you went to three colleges. No, I went to... I went to Welfelforce University. I went to Southern University of Welfelforce University. I didn't finish college. You didn't go to... That's why my dad said, if you don't finish college, you're going to have to lay bricks. That's why I had to go to lay bricks. He said, you stop. He said, you quit college? He said, you start laying bricks. So I had to lay bricks. I'd wear gloves because I didn't want to get my hands dirty. I couldn't be... You know, you couldn't make those runs with a brick hand. It was all full of lime and cement. So I would just go out on that job and pick up those bricks and everything with my gloves. I would say... They'd say I was a dude, you know, with fancy bricklayers. God couldn't help me. I'm going to be a songwriter. They'd all laugh at me. So that guy, who's on that pile of bricks over there, is going to be a songwriter. They don't laugh. He said, that guy is going to be a bricklayer. He's going to be a songwriter. Can you imagine that? Hey, songwriter. And I would say, all right, you'll see someday. I'll show you someday. I'll be a... I'm going to be... My uncle said, you think you're going to be like Irving Berlin? I said, you think you're going to be... I said, maybe so. I don't say I'll be as great as Irving Berlin, but I said, I might use him as my... You know, as a... As a goal, so that I can maybe sort of reach up there. Maybe I can be halfway as great as Irving Berlin. So that was some of the things that you... You know, hassles that you go through. People doubting you. You're even doubting yourself.
